title: Hotel Continental, Tangier, Morocco
content: The couryard of the Hotel Continental in Tangier, Morocco is wedged between the the busy harbor and the crowded medina. It is the “dream at the end of the world,” inhabited by the ghosts of the Beat expatriates.The American Paul Bowles lived there for 52 years. He attracted his eccentric friends William Burroughs, Truman Capote, Timothy Leary, and Jack Kerouac. Their wild adventures found their way into works likeAmericaby Allen Ginsberg,Let It Come Downby Paul Bowles,Desolation Angelsby Jack Kerouac, andThe Thief's Journalby Jean Genet.------P.S.
